info.name: DIPS Gate SDK
info.description:
Postman collection for the Raspberry Pi gate device API endpoints.

Includes authentication, gate verification, face verification, and enrollment status endpoints.

Usage:
1. Set the {{base_url}} variable to your backend URL
2. Run the 'Login' request first to obtain a JWT token
3. The token is automatically saved to the {{jwt_token}} variable
4. All other requests use {{jwt_token}} in the Authorization header

request.description:
Authenticate the gate device and obtain a JWT token.

The token should be copied to the {{jwt_token}} collection variable for use in subsequent requests.

Response includes: token, type (Bearer), user id, email, name, and role.

exec: console.log('JWT token saved to collection variable');

request.description: Test login with invalid credentials. Expected: 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: Gate Verification
item.description:
Primary gate verification endpoint. Sends a face image and receives an access decision.

This is the main endpoint used by the Raspberry Pi gate controller.

Endpoint: POST /api/gate/verify
Underlying: POST /api/access-verification/verify

The backend performs:
1. Face detection and quality check
2. Face embedding extraction (via FastAPI + InsightFace)
3. Face matching against enrolled users
4. Vehicle registration lookup
5. Access decision (ALLOW or DENY)

formdata.description: JPEG or PNG face image captured from the gate camera. Max 10 MB. Recommended: 640x480 or 1280x720.

request.description:
Send a face image for access verification.

Multipart form-data with a single 'image' field containing a JPEG or PNG file.

The backend will:
1. Detect and validate the face in the image
2. Extract a 512-dimensional ArcFace embedding
3. Compare against all enrolled face embeddings
4. If match found, check vehicle registration
5. Return ALLOW or DENY decision

Expected response (ALLOW):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "decision": "ALLOW",
    "reason": "VERIFIED",
    "confidence": 0.87,
    "user": { ... },
    "vehicle": { ... }
  }
}
Test gate verification without authentication. Expected: 401 Unauthorized.
Test gate verification with an expired JWT token. Expected: 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: Face Verification (Standalone)
item.description:
Standalone face verification endpoint. Only performs face matching without access decision logic.

Endpoint: POST /api/face-verification/verify

Use this for testing face recognition independently of the full access verification flow.

request.description:
Verify a face image against enrolled users.

Returns:
- faceMatched: boolean
- confidence: float (0.0 — 1.0)
- matchedUserId: number
- matchedUserName: string

Note: This endpoint only checks face match. Use /gate/verify for the full access decision.
Test face verification with an unknown face. Expected: faceMatched = false.

item.name: Access Verification
item.description:
Full access verification endpoint (direct backend path).

Endpoint: POST /api/access-verification/verify

This is the underlying endpoint that /gate/verify maps to. Use this for direct backend testing.

Performs the complete verification pipeline:
1. Face detection and quality validation
2. ArcFace embedding extraction via InsightFace (FastAPI)
3. Cosine similarity comparison against enrolled embeddings
4. Vehicle registration check for matched user
5. Access decision generation
6. Access log entry creation

request.description:
Full access verification with face image.

Response fields:
- accessGranted: boolean
- userId: number (matched user ID)
- userName: string
- faceMatched: boolean
- faceConfidence: float
- vehicleFound: boolean
- vehiclePlate: string
- reason: string (VERIFIED, NO_MATCH, NO_FACE, etc.)
- decision: string (ALLOW, DENY)
- timestamp: ISO datetime
- accessLogId: number

item.name: Face Enrollment Status
item.description:
Check the face enrollment status for the authenticated user.

Endpoint: GET /api/face-enrollment/status

Useful for verifying that a user has completed enrollment before expecting successful verification.

request.description:
Get the face enrollment status for the authenticated user.

Response includes:
- enrolled: boolean
- status: string (NOT_STARTED, PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED)
- imageCount: number
- enrolledAt: ISO datetime or null

item.name: User Profile
item.description: User profile endpoints. Useful for verifying the authenticated device account.

request.description:
Get the profile of the currently authenticated user (device account).

Useful for verifying that the gate device is authenticated correctly.

item.name: Plate Verification
item.description:
License plate verification endpoint. Optional — for gates with ANPR cameras.

Endpoint: POST /api/plate-verification/verify

formdata.description: Image containing a vehicle license plate

request.description:
Verify a license plate image.

This endpoint is optional for the gate device. The primary verification path uses face recognition.

Returns plate detection results and verification status.

item.name: Health & Diagnostics
item.description: Endpoints for health checking and diagnostics.

request.description:
Use the login endpoint as a health check. A 400 or 401 response indicates the server is running. A connection timeout or refusal indicates the server is down.

Expected: 400 (Bad Request) or 401 (Unauthorized) — both confirm the server is alive.

item.name: Error Scenarios
item.description: Test various error conditions to verify the gate controller handles them correctly.

request.description: Send a verification request without an image. Expected: 400 Bad Request.
Send a request with a malformed JWT. Expected: 401 Unauthorized.
